<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13012024-10-215-13-39" status="finalized">
         <milestone unit="section" n="2.1 mngon sum la log rtogs dgag pa"/>
         <lb n="24a6"/> dang po ni <rs type="person" ref="db:3786" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha cig</rs> tshu rol mthong pa rnams ni yul dang dus dang skye mched ma phye bar gang la zhen pa drangs pa'i don la mi slu bas tshad mar 'gyur ba yin ste | zhen pa ni tshad ma'i byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro || de lta ma yin na 'gro ba na spyad pa'i don thob pa'i mi slu ba nyid mi srid par 'gyur te mthong pa'i dngos po rnams  <lb n="24a7"/> 'jug par gzo' ba na 'gag pa'i phyir ro || de lta yin dang me dang chu'i kha dog 'dzin pa ni tsha ba dang gsher ba'i zhen pa 'dren pa nyid kyis reg pa la tshad ma yin no zhes zer ro || <note type="editorial">This corresponds to the position of <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rNgog lo tsa ba</rs> </note>
         de ni mi rung ste | don myong pa'i stobs kyis rtogs pa myed pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
